newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Five Dubai cargoes offered to India in Mar tender.
newsitem.headline: Five Dubai cargoes offered to India in Mar tender.

text.p: At least five cargoes of Dubai crude oil have been offered into the March crude buying tender of state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC), traders said on Friday.
They said the cargoes were offered by four companies at prices ranging first-half quotes +43 cents to +56 cents.
Five oil firms offered very large crude carriers of West African Qua Iboe crude oil, but price levels were not clear.
One trader offered Gulf of Suez Blend at official selling prices -5 cents, traders said.
A European major offered a VLCC of West African Palanca grade crude, they said.
In its February tender, India awarded just one Dubai crude after receiving 10 offers and it also took two VLCCs of Qua Iboe.
